page.layout: One page of verse, full width; running head at top with page number at top right. No margin notes. Speaker names in small capitals as centred headings, each followed by its verse stanza.

main_text.head: VENVS.
main_text.p: CEsset amor, pariter cessabunt fœdera rerum: In chaos antiquum cuncta elementa ruent.
main_text.head: CERES.
main_text.p: SI parili cincta fugiant connubia voto, Rara tui fiet Delia turba chori.
main_text.head: PALLAS.
main_text.p: SI pariter fugiant omnes connubia nimphæ, Nullus erit posthac virginitatis honos.
main_text.head: SATVRNVS.
main_text.p: SI tibi fas fuerit tædis arcere puellas, Cur mihi fas non sit prasecuisse mares?
main_text.head: MARS.
main_text.p: VN de mihi miles? si totum transfigat aium Fœmineum in sterili virginitate genus.
main_text.head: MERCVRIVS.
main_text.p: FUstra & ego docea eloquium, liquidaing, pala- Et celerem Eoa merce onerare ratem. (stram,
main_text.head: APOLLO.
main_text.p: DElia parce metu, meaq, hac simul accipe dicta, Qua tibi veridico prasciu ore cano. Iuno vocat, Mariasque tuas iubet esse maritas, Castaque legitimi iura subire thori. Multiplicesque tibi Marios Mariasque rependent, Accrescetque tuis longior ordo choris.

page.notes: Printed page is a single column of verse. Some words in the Mercurius and Apollo stanzas are doubtful (e.g. "Rustra", "docea", "ratem", "prasciu"); the final line of the Mercurius stanza ends with a fragment "(stram," which is printed as is. Catchword and signature not printed.
